column1: # Eight invented genomes, two drugs, shaped the way
# mic**. Every number here is made up. The generator for the real
# thing is MutationScan's own synthetic cohort
# this file exists so the module can be exercised end to end before
# The design is deliberately uneven -- gyrA/parC carriers sit at low
# ciprofloxacin MICs, aac carriers sit at high gentamicin ones, and
# acrB is uncorrelated -- so the gene-drug association test has
# something to find and something to miss.
# Where to get the real thing: BV-BRC (successor to PATRIC) at
# https://www.bv-brc.org/, free academic registration, then either the
# web UI or `p3-get-phenotype-data`. Column names in a BV-BRC export
# differ from these; the loader matches them case-insensitively and
# MIC values are on a doubling dilution series, so they are log2 steps
# -- the scale `burden_correlation` reports on. Censored readings
# (`<=0.25`, `>64`) are accepted and collapse to a comparable
